one_line: Drukpa Kagyu king of Ladakh navigating the 1679–1684 Tibet–Ladakh–Mughal frontier war and the Treaty of Temisgam.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but hardy mountain build
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, light brown weathered complexion, straight nose, narrow dark-brown eyes with focused intensity, trimmed moustache and short goatee, default expression a calm, calculating gaze that hints at both strain and resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a single mid-length topknot at the crown, the rest tied back and tucked; a dark maroon woollen headband wraps the base of the topknot, and a narrow golden circlet with a small central turquoise cabochon rests over the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, thick chuba-style robe of deep maroon wool reaching mid-calf, wrap-tied to the right with a broad dark indigo wool sash; beneath, a high-collared saffron-yellow under-tunic shows at the neck and cuffs, and a sleeveless dark-brown quilted cotton jerkin is worn over the chest for light armour; the robe’s cuffs are edged with narrow woven borders in muted geometric patterns of rust and cream; he has a simple dark-brown leather belt with a brass buckle, from which hang a small leather pouch and a prayer-bead loop; his trousers are natural undyed wool in a light grey-beige, tucked into sturdy dark-brown leather boots lined with wool and reinforced at the toes; over his shoulders sits a thick, dark charcoal-grey wool cloak, clasped at the right shoulder with a small brass pin, practical for high-altitude cold; jewellery is restrained—small turquoise and silver stud earrings and a single silver ring with a turquoise stone on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Indo-Tibetan steel sword with a plain brass crossguard, dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt, and simple scabbard of dark wood bound in leather, carried at his left hip and often rested in his right hand by the hilt as he stands in thought.

ref_desc: Delegs Namgyal is a mid-30s Ladakhi king with an oval weathered face, narrow dark eyes, black hair in a topknot under a maroon headband and gold-turquoise circlet, wearing a deep maroon chuba, saffron under-tunic, dark jerkin, indigo sash, charcoal cloak and grey wool trousers with dark boots, carrying a curved Indo-Tibetan sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Delegs Namgyal, a mid-30s Ladakhi king with an oval, high-cheekboned, light-brown weathered face, narrow dark-brown eyes, a trimmed moustache and short goatee, and thick black hair tied into a single topknot wrapped with a dark maroon headband and a narrow golden circlet bearing a small turquoise stone on his forehead; dress him in a long deep maroon wool chuba-style robe wrapped to the right and secured with a broad dark indigo wool sash, a saffron-yellow high-collared under-tunic visible at neck and cuffs, and a dark-brown sleeveless quilted jerkin over his chest, with narrow rust-and-cream geometric borders on the robe’s cuffs; give him a simple dark-brown leather belt with a brass buckle, a small leather pouch and prayer beads at his waist, light grey-beige wool trousers tucked into dark-brown leather highland boots lined with wool, and a thick charcoal-grey wool cloak clasped at his right shoulder with a brass pin; add small turquoise-and-silver stud earrings and a single silver ring with turquoise on his right hand; his signature weapon is a slightly curved Indo-Tibetan steel sword with a plain brass crossguard, dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt, and simple dark wooden scabbard bound in leather, hanging at his left hip and shown resting in his right hand; use a colour palette of deep maroon, saffron yellow, dark indigo, charcoal grey and turquoise, and keep his default expression calm, serious and strategically thoughtful.
